name: Custom Product Badges
author: Galaxy Weblinks

sections.description:
Custom Product Badges allows you to add beautiful, customizable badges to your WooCommerce products. Set custom text, colors for badge.
For any feedback or queries regarding this plugin, please contact our Support team.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/custom-product-badges
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the WooCommerce -> Products screen to configure badges for individual products
  4. You can find the ‘Badge Text’ field in the Advanced tab of the product settings.
sections.faq:
Where can I add badges to my products?

You can add badges to individual products from the WooCommerce -> Products screen. Navigate to the Advanced tab in the product settings where you’ll find the ‘Badge Text’ field.

Can I customize the appearance of badges?

Yes, you can customize both the text and colors of your badges. The plugin allows you to set:

Custom badge text
Background color
Font color

Where will the badges appear on my store?

Badges are displayed in two locations:

On the shop/category pages where products are listed
On individual product pages

Can I add multiple badges to a single product?

Currently, the plugin supports one badge per product. We’re considering adding multiple badge support in future updates.
